description: The container and grid system, verbatim from src/index.css @layer components.

container.nesting: `.container .container { padding-inline: 0 }` — a nested container contributes no extra gutter.
container.paddingOnlyHelper: .container-padding-x applies the same 20px -> 48px padding-inline with no max-width

sectionShell.pattern: <section class="relative overflow-clip <bg> <padding-ramp> <text-colour>"> > <div class="container relative z-1 flex flex-col <block-gap>"> > one <div> per content block
sectionShell.note: There is NO extracted <Section> component in the real source — every section component owns its own <section> wrapper. Verified: all 25 section-bearing components contain exactly one <section> element each.

zIndexScale.note: only two bespoke z-index steps exist; brackets use z-10 from the Tailwind default scale

stats.cards.cellOverlap: margin-right/-bottom: -1px on all but the last card so hairlines merge
stats.cards.correction: CLONE_SPEC.md §4.5 claims a single 326px column at 390. That is WRONG — measured on the original at 390 the grid is `grid-template-columns: 175px 175px`. The grid is unconditionally 2-col.
